title: Evaluating the while Expression
description: The evaluator method that runs a while loop: evaluate the condition, type-check it as a boolean, return 0 when it is false, and otherwise run the body again.

steps.description: This adds `eval_WhileExpr` in `evaluator.py`. The page calls this step 4, evaluating the `while` expression to make the test Green.
`eval_WhileExpr` loops forever and evaluates the condition each pass. It checks whether the condition is a `bool`.
When the condition is not a `bool`, it raises `LangTypeError` with a message that names the expected type and the actual type, plus the node's line.

When the condition is false, the method returns 0. Otherwise it evaluates the body and loops again. The page says a `while` loop's value is not meaningful, so it returns 0 when the condition becomes false.
